red_tests.failure_fingerprint: SyntaxError: The requested module '../api/index.js' does not provide an export named 'configuredBackendOrigin'

rationale: Correction history: Sequence 1 scoped KAN-276 to api/index.js only. Independent verification found the same dead HF code at a SECOND site the plan missed, api/gateway.js, which is reachable in production: api/health.js calls its proxyToBackend(), and that function resolves its upstream through gateway.js's own configuredBackendOrigin()/HF_BACKEND_ORIGIN. With HF_BACKEND_URL unset in the Vercel environment the guard `if (!HF_BACKEND_ORIGIN) return sendPublicError(res, 503, ...)` fired, so live https://horo-consultant-psi.vercel.app/api/health answered a PERMANENT 503 that no retry could clear. Three further test files pinned the superseded HF contract and are updated in this baseline rather than deleted: the two admin ingress tests imported the now-removed configuredBackendOrigin export from api/index.js (a hard module SyntaxError, not a soft assertion failure) and pointed HF_BACKEND_URL at the retired Space; api_gateway_cors_contract.test.mjs asserted the HF origin shape, drove api/gateway.js through HF_BACKEND_URL, and expected handleWakeRequest's old 'paused_unauthenticated' status where the honest status is now 'unavailable'. Verified: node suite 72 pass / 2 fail on main -> 74 pass / 2 fail here, the same two pre-existing Vercel-config failures, zero new failures; and api/health.js now resolves Render and returns 200 where it previously returned 503.  Freeze the corrected KAN-276 contract before the source fix for the second HF site. api/gateway.js's configuredBackendOrigin() accepted any *.hf.space host and its HF_BACKEND_ORIGIN constant fed proxyToBackend(), the upstream used by api/health.js; with HF_BACKEND_URL unset that produced a permanent 503 on the live Vercel /api/health. The source change repoints gateway.js at the canonical Render origin (keeping the exported name because api/health.js and the contract tests import it) and updates api/health.js's comment. The three test files here previously pinned the superseded HF contract — two of them by importing a symbol that api/index.js no longer exports, which is a module-load SyntaxError that aborted those files entirely rather than failing one assertion.
